title: The SuperActivator Mechanism: Transformers Concentrate Reliable Concept Signals in the Tail
abstract: arXiv:2512.05038v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Concept vectors aim to enhance model interpretability by linking learned internal representations with human-understandable semantics, but their practical utility is often limited by noisy and inconsistent activations. In this work, we discover the SuperActivator Mechanism: a transformer dynamic that amplifies concept activation gaps, concentrating the most reliable concept evidence into a small set of highly activated tokens, which we call SuperActivators. We theoretically characterize this mechanism, proving that concept-aligned attention produces two competing effects: a tail amplification effect, where gaps among already-high activations grow disproportionately fast, and an equalization effect that eventually dominates as attention concentrates on extreme tokens. We validate the predicted tail amplification empirically, finding that in-concept activation distributions develop well-separated upper tails consistently across models,

translated_title: 超级激活器机制：Transformer 将可靠的概念信号集中在尾部
translated_abstract: 概念向量旨在通过将模型学习到的内部表示与人类可理解的语义联系起来，从而增强模型的可解释性，但其实际效用常常受到嘈杂且不一致的激活的限制。在本工作中，我们发现了超级激活器机制：这是一种 Transformer 的动态特性，它会放大概念激活之间的差距，将最可靠的概念证据集中到一小部分高度激活的 token 中，我们将其称为超级激活器。我们从理论上对这一机制进行了刻画，证明了与概念对齐的注意力会产生两种相互竞争的效应：一种是尾部放大效应，即已经较高的激活之间的差距会不成比例地快速增长；另一种是均衡化效应，当注意力集中于极端 token 时，均衡化效应最终会占据主导地位。我们通过实证验证了所预测的尾部放大效应，发现在各模型中，概念内的激活分布一致地形成了分离良好的上尾部。
tldr: 该论文发现并理论刻画了 Transformer 中的“超级激活器机制”：概念对齐的注意力会放大激活差距，将最可靠的概念证据集中到少数高激活 token 的尾部上，从而提升基于概念向量的模型可解释性的可靠性。
